hint.label: Vocabulary

atoms.b: The deadliest terrorist attack in recent history occurred on September 11, 2001. The Islamist extremist group al-Qaeda ((++hijacked searched)) four passenger planes.
One plane was ((++flown sailed)) to the Pentagon in Arlington County, Virginia. Another plane was ((++heading_for leaving))  Washington D.C., but instead crashed in a field in Pennsylvania.

The other two planes were flown into The Twin Towers of the World Trade Center in Manhattan. The Twin Towers were the tallest buildings and the centerpieces of the World Trade Center in New York City. They ((++collapsed rose)) due to the damage from the impacts and the resulting fires.

Almost 3,000 people from 90 nations were killed by the attack. It was an ((++assault analysis)) on Western civilisation and the global standing of the USA. New buildings have been ((++constructed removed)) and a memorial and museum now stand on the site where the Twin Towers once stood.

instruction.text: Read the statements below about the consequences of the 9/11 attack. Drag each statement into the correct category of consequences.

atoms.b: Flight safety measures and airport security were strengthened across the globe.
U.S. President Bush led an invasion of Afghanistan, supported by an international coalition, in order to fight al‑Qaeda.
President Bush declared a ‘War on Terror’: the USA would attack before other countries could threaten America's security.
The U.S. government increased security measures to protect Americans.

hint.label: to freeze assets

atoms.b: President Bush signed an executive order freezing the assets of terrorists and organisations that have financially supported terrorism.
The USA passed the Patriot Act, a new law that allowed controversial measures such as extensive data collection to prevent terrorist attacks.
9/11 led to a fearful atmosphere in the USA; many people felt unsafe in everyday life.
American Muslims experienced more hate crimes, discrimination and negative stereotyping.
